_paper_reported.note: Numbers the paper reports that are not scored results of this gym. The paper does not publish its coupling constants, so absolute errors on this gym's fixed instance are not on the paper's scale. Kept unchanged for context.

three_spin_binary.efnn_setting: 2 or 3 layers, at least 105 neurons per layer

three_spin_continuous.status: not scored: the reproduced continuous-spin EFNN (RMSE about 0.155 on the earlier public instance) did not validate against the paper, and the experiment was removed from official scoring in iteration 9

three_spin_binary.description: 15-site binary three-spin infinite-range energy prediction on a fixed hidden coupling instance; models are trained on 16,000 public samples and scored on every configuration absent from the public files. Paper reports EFNN relative error below 5e-3 for 2/3 layers with at least 105 neurons.

relative_error.description: RMSE of predicted energies on the scored configurations divided by the absolute mean true energy; the paper's headline accuracy metric for the binary task.

mae.description: Mean absolute energy error on the scored configurations; rewards broadly accurate regression rather than optimizing only squared error.

tail_rmse.description: RMSE on the quartile of scored configurations with the largest true energy magnitude; catches methods that fit only near-centre configurations.

param_count.description: Constraint, measured by the evaluator from the submitted model file: every stored numeric value (sub-32-bit types count one per element, wider types one per 4 bytes). Hard budget of 100,000: a model above it fails the run. Reported, not ranked, because the paper compares accuracy at comparable model scale.
